events.title: Samuel Hamilton settles in the Salinas Valley
events.summary: Samuel and Liza Hamilton come from Ireland and take up poor hill land near King City. Samuel becomes the valley's inventive, generous blacksmith, well-digger and midwife.
events.rationale: Places Samuel where he can later befriend Adam, deliver and name the twins, and tell Adam where Cathy is.

events.title: Cyrus Trask dies leaving a large fortune
events.summary: Adam learns that their father has died and left the brothers a surprisingly large fortune of doubtful origin. The money keeps both brothers comfortable on the Connecticut farm.
events.rationale: The inheritance later lets Adam buy a California ranch and fund the lettuce scheme whose loss drives Cal's plan.

events.title: Cathy burns her parents' house and fakes her death
events.summary: Teenaged Cathy Ames sets fire to her family home, killing her parents, and makes it look as if she died too. She then leaves town under a new identity.
events.rationale: Starts Cathy's path of reinvention that leads her to Edwards and then to the Trasks.

events.title: Mr. Edwards beats Cathy nearly to death
events.summary: Cathy becomes the mistress of the whoremaster Mr. Edwards and manipulates him. When he learns of her schemes he beats her savagely and leaves her for dead.
events.rationale: The beating leaves Cathy crawling for help, which brings her to the Trask farm.

events.title: Injured Cathy turns up at the Trask farmhouse
events.summary: The broken, bloodied Cathy reaches the Trask brothers' door. Adam is tender toward her while Charles distrusts her at once.
events.rationale: Brings Cathy into Adam's life, the start of the marriage that produces Cal and Aron.

events.title: Adam marries Cathy
events.summary: Infatuated, Adam marries the recovering Cathy despite Charles's warnings. He announces he will take her to California.
events.rationale: The marriage makes Cathy the twins' mother and sets the move west.

events.title: Cathy drugs Adam and goes to Charles on the wedding night
events.summary: On her wedding night Cathy gives Adam the sleeping medicine meant for her and goes to Charles's bed. The twins' paternity is left uncertain.
events.rationale: Shows Cathy's nature and clouds which brother fathered the twins, feeding the Cain-and-Abel inheritance Cal fears.

events.title: Adam buys the Bordoni ranch
events.summary: Adam brings the pregnant Cathy to the Salinas Valley and buys the old Bordoni place near King City. He dreams of making a garden of it.
events.rationale: Places the Trasks near the Hamiltons and near Salinas, where Cathy will later run a brothel.

events.title: Samuel comes to plan Adam's wells
events.summary: Samuel comes to the Trask place to plan wells for Adam. He begins a lasting friendship with Adam and feels uneasy about Cathy.
events.rationale: Ties the Hamilton thread to the Trasks, so Samuel is on hand for the birth and later guidance.

events.title: Lee drops his pidgin with Samuel
events.summary: Adam's Chinese servant Lee recognizes Samuel's sympathy and speaks to him in fluent English. The two become close friends and thinkers.
events.rationale: Begins the Lee-Samuel bond behind the naming of the twins and Lee's role as their true parent.

events.title: Samuel delivers the twins and Cathy bites him
events.summary: Samuel delivers Cathy's twin boys. Cathy, cold and hostile, bites his hand savagely during the birth.
events.rationale: Brings Cal and Aron into the world, the two brothers of the focal event.

events.title: Cathy shoots Adam and abandons the family
events.summary: A week after the birth Cathy announces she is leaving. When Adam tries to stop her she shoots him in the shoulder and walks out on her husband and sons.
events.rationale: Her desertion creates the hidden-mother secret that Cal later exposes to Aron.

events.title: Horace Quinn investigates the shooting
events.summary: Deputy Horace Quinn questions Adam, who insists the shooting was an accident. The sheriff learns where Cathy has gone but keeps it quiet.
events.rationale: The cover-up keeps Cathy's fate hidden, so the boys grow up thinking their mother is gone.

events.title: Cathy goes to work at Faye's brothel as Kate
events.summary: Cathy arrives in Salinas and joins Faye's house under the name Kate. She quickly makes herself Faye's favorite.
events.rationale: Starts Kate's Salinas life, putting her in the town where her sons will live.

events.title: Kate poisons Faye and takes over the brothel
events.summary: After Faye names her heir, Kate slowly poisons her. Faye dies, and Kate inherits the house, which she turns into a notorious establishment.
events.rationale: Gives Kate the brothel that Cal later visits and to which he takes Aron.

events.title: Samuel strikes Adam out of his stupor
events.summary: Finding the twins still unnamed over a year after Cathy left, Samuel provokes and strikes the numb Adam. Adam begins to wake to his sons.
events.rationale: Rouses Adam enough to name and father the boys.

events.title: The twins are named Caleb and Aron
events.summary: Lee, Samuel and Adam read the Cain and Abel story and discuss rejection and guilt. They name the boys Caleb and Aron.
events.rationale: Sets the Cain-Abel frame and the brothers' identities that the focal betrayal plays out.

events.title: Samuel, aging after Una's death, agrees to leave his ranch
events.summary: Grief over his daughter Una's death ages Samuel, and his children arrange to move him off the ranch. He makes farewell visits.
events.rationale: His farewell visit to Adam is when he decides to tell Adam the truth about Cathy.

events.title: Samuel tells Adam that Cathy runs a Salinas brothel
events.summary: After Lee explains timshel, Samuel tells Adam that Cathy is Kate, keeper of a Salinas whorehouse. He hopes the truth will free Adam.
events.rationale: Lets Adam face Kate and break free, which leads to the move to Salinas.

events.title: Adam confronts Kate and is freed of her
events.summary: After Samuel's funeral Adam visits Kate's brothel. She mocks him and boasts of blackmail photographs, and Adam leaves released from his obsession.
events.rationale: Adam is free to rebuild his life and later move the family to Salinas, near Kate.

events.title: Aron gives Abra a rabbit
events.summary: When the Bacons shelter from rain at the Trask ranch, Aron offers Abra a rabbit in a box. Abra prefers the gentle Aron, while Cal feels shut out.
events.rationale: Begins the Aron-Abra bond and sharpens Cal's jealousy of his favored brother.

events.title: Abra tells Aron his mother may be alive
events.summary: Abra repeats gossip that the Trask boys' mother is not dead but ran away. Aron clings to his belief in a dead, pure mother.
events.rationale: Shows Aron's idealized image of his mother, which the focal reveal shatters.

events.title: Adam moves the family to Salinas
events.summary: Adam moves the household to Salinas for the boys' schooling. The twins now live in the same town as Kate's house.
events.rationale: Puts the boys within reach of Kate, making Cal's discovery and the visit possible.

events.title: Adam's iced-lettuce venture fails
events.summary: Adam ships Salinas lettuce east packed in ice, but delays let it rot. He loses much of his fortune and is mocked in town.
events.rationale: Cal later tries to win his father's love by replacing the lost money.

events.title: Aron turns to the church
events.summary: Aron takes up fervent religion under the Episcopal minister Mr. Rolf and talks of chastity and the priesthood. His purity makes him fragile.
events.rationale: Aron's piety makes the brothel revelation devastating.

events.title: Cal is picked up in a Chinatown raid
events.summary: Cal, prowling at night, is caught in a police raid on a Chinatown gambling house. Adam comes to take him home.
events.rationale: The walk home becomes the moment Adam tells Cal about his mother.

events.title: Adam tells Cal the truth about his mother
events.summary: Adam admits that the boys' mother is alive and runs a house in Salinas. Cal already half-knows and is troubled by her legacy in himself.
events.rationale: Cal now holds the secret he later uses against Aron.

events.title: Cal shadows Kate around Salinas
events.summary: Cal secretly follows Kate on her outings to study the woman who is his mother. He grows obsessed with whether her evil is in him.
events.rationale: Leads Cal to confront Kate and learn her house.

events.title: Cal confronts Kate in her room
events.summary: Cal enters Kate's house and faces her, rejecting the idea that he is like her. Kate has him thrown out.
events.rationale: Cal now knows the way into Kate's house, which he uses to take Aron there.

events.title: America enters the war; Adam joins the draft board
events.summary: The United States enters World War I and Adam serves on the local draft board. Sending young men to war weighs on his conscience.
events.rationale: War makes Cal's bean profits possible and makes Adam see them as war profiteering.

events.title: Lee lends Cal five thousand dollars
events.summary: Lee lends Cal money from the savings he once meant for a bookstore. Cal wants to earn back what Adam lost.
events.rationale: Funds the bean venture behind Cal's gift.

events.title: Cal and Will Hamilton profit from beans
events.summary: Cal partners with Will Hamilton to contract beans cheaply and sell them high to wartime buyers. Cal clears about fifteen thousand dollars.
events.rationale: Produces the money Cal offers Adam, whose rejection triggers his revenge on Aron.

events.title: Aron leaves for Stanford
events.summary: Aron graduates early and goes to Stanford, to Adam's great pride. Away from home he idealizes his family and Abra.
events.rationale: Adam's pride in Aron sharpens Cal's sense of rejection, and Aron's return home sets up the visit.

events.title: Adam rejects Cal's Thanksgiving gift
events.summary: At Thanksgiving Cal gives Adam the money. Adam refuses it as profit from war and says he would rather have the goodness Aron has.
events.rationale: The direct trigger: hurt and jealous, Cal decides to wound Aron.

events.title: Cal takes Aron to Kate's house
events.summary: That night Cal leads Aron to Kate's brothel and shows him that the madam is their mother. Aron is shattered.
events.rationale: The focal event, where the Trask and Cathy/Kate threads meet.
